memories.text: Database too many connections and high p99 latency indicate connection pool exhaustion under the legacy thread pool driver. Raise db_pool_size to 80, then restart the affected worker.

Database too many connections and high p99 latency indicate connection pool exhaustion under the legacy thread pool driver. Since the platform migrated the service to the multiplexed connection pool driver, raising db_pool_size no longer has any effect -- enable pool_multiplexing_enabled instead.
Cache timeout cascade reduced storefront availability on the on-prem cache topology. Fail over storefront-cache to the on-prem redis replica.

Cache timeout cascade reduced storefront availability on the on-prem cache topology. Since the platform migrated to the managed cache topology and decommissioned the on-prem replica, fail over storefront-cache to the managed cache primary instead.
